shortDescription: Information module for Network Devices Intent Count

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: family
options.description: Family query parameter. Product family of the network device. For example, Switches, Routers, etc.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. Network device Id.

options.name: managementAddress
options.description: ManagementAddress query parameter. Management address of the network device.

options.name: managementState
options.description: ManagementState query parameter. The status of the network device's manageability. Available values MANAGED, UNDER_MAINTENANCE, NEVER_MANAGED. Refer features for more details.

options.name: reachabilityStatus
options.description: ReachabilityStatus query parameter. Reachability status of the network device. Available values REACHABLE, ONLY_PING_REACHABLE, UNREACHABLE, UNKNOWN. Refer features for more details.

options.name: role
options.description: Role query parameter. Role assigned to the network device. Available values BORDER_ROUTER, CORE, DISTRIBUTION, ACCESS, UNKNOWN.

options.name: serialNumber
options.description: SerialNumber query parameter. Serial number of the network device.

options.name: stackDevice
options.description: StackDevice query parameter. Flag indicating if the device is a stack device.

options.name: status
options.description: Status query parameter. Inventory related status of the network device. Available values MANAGED, SYNC_NOT_STARTED, SYNC_INIT_FAILED, SYNC_PRECHECK_FAILED, SYNC_IN_PROGRESS, SYNC_INTERNAL_ERROR, SYNC_DISABLED, DELETING_DEVICE, UNDER_MAINTENANCE, QUARANTINED, UNASSOCIATED, UNREACHABLE, UNKNOWN. Refer features for more details.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
